dedupe_keys.name: the road network similarity calculation based on autoencoders and its application in map generalization quality evaluation

description: A Lanzhou Jiaotong University team describes multi-scale road-network representations for Chengdu, Wuhan, Kunming, Shenzhen and Hefei. Zenodo lists public shapefile components under CC BY 4.0. The provider says the source was OpenStreetMap accessed in June 2025, with an original 1:10,000 road graph and expert generalisation at five coarser map scales. Connectivity and geometry features include node degree, segment length, tortuosity and directional measures. These networks can test how topology simplification affects transport-flow or accessibility simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this five-city collection. A limitation is that the description refers to thirty GeoJSON files, while the visible inventory contains 34 shapefile components; the exact number of usable scales per city was not checked. The stated quality assessment is cartographic, not proof of road status, capacity or traffic demand. The public files were not downloaded and no graph statistic was reproduced.
